## Problem Statement / Opportunity
Is your feature request related to a problem or a gap in current TOEIC training workflows?
(e.g., "I wish agents could analyze phonetic accuracy automatically" or "Add Part 5 Listening & Reading seed bank")

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what tool, prompt, resource, or simulator feature you would like added.

## Proposed MCP Interface (if applicable)
If you're proposing a new MCP tool, prompt, or resource, outline the signature:
```json
{
  "tool": "example_tool_name",
  "parameters": { ... }
}
```

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, ETS rubric guidelines, or screenshots here.
